About the College
a.    Establishment
Government Model College, Borkhola (GMCB) was set up in the year 2020 in Cachar district under Assam Government’s initiative to set up 15 model colleges in rural areas in the State with Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan’s (RUSA) financial assistance to provide quality Higher education to the students of rural areas of Borkhola. Out of total model colleges to be set up, nine were planned to set up exclusively for women and other six were to set up as co-educational colleges and Government Model College, Borkhola is one of those six co-educational colleges that was set up in the rural area of Borkhola. Like other Model colleges, GMCB, too was set up at the cost of Rs. 9.00 Crores and was inaugurated in the digital mode by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi Ji on 3
rd
February, 2019 and became functional with its first batch of students from 2020-2021’s academic session. Unlike other state colleges set up and provincialized by the state Government, GMCB, like other newly created Model colleges of the state, is set up and directly run by the State Government.
Read More
b.    The College
The college offers Undergraduate Pass course in the subjects such as English, Economics, Political Science and Sociology following CBCS system under the affiliation of Assam University, Silchar (Central University). The Higher Secondary course in Arts Stream is also made available in the college under the Assam Higher Secondary Education Council (AHSEC). The college provides library along with reading room facilities for the students and have large spacious classrooms for conducting classes. The college, at present, is having a group of young, energetic, experienced and dynamic faculty members who provide blended education that is based on learner-centered approach that includes individual mentorship of students, regular carrier counselling and guidance for various competitive examinations both at the state and the national level. The college gives priority for the all-round development of the students that ensures that the students learn their courses imbibing leadership skills, professional skills with special attention given to inculcating values in them.
c.     Location
The college is located at DHOLCHERA, Borkhola nearby NATRIP point and is situated 20 kms away from Silchar Railway Station. The college is well commutable having all sorts of road transport available to reach the college campus. The infrastructure of the college is constructed on its campus that spreads over 38 (thirty eight) bighas of land. The infrastructure plan of the college also includes residential facilities for teaching, non-teaching staff and for the female students.
From the Principal’s Desk
“Education is the most powerful weapon.
We can use to change the world”
Nelson Mandela
It’s my proud privilege to say that the Government of Assam has introduced a scheme with central assistance for establishment of Model Degree Colleges in educationally backward districts where Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) for higher education is less than the national GER. Although initially these institutions are developed as institutions for Higher Secondary and undergraduate level education, the government has the plan of introducing Post Graduate (PG) level in these institutions in the future.
The Government Model College, Borkhola, Cachar was established in 2020. The college has a vast campus spread over 38 (thirty eight) bighas.  It is situated on a unique zero pollution hilltop surrounded by hills and greenery at Borkhola.  It’s a dream project of the Government of Assam with financial support from Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA).
Read More
The setting up of the college has opened up the doors of higher education in the economically and educationally backward region of Assam. Institutions like ours have a very significant role to play in the socio-economic development of Borkhola in particular and Assam in general.
This Model College became functional from the academic year 2020-2021 with both Higher Secondary courses (10+2) in the arts stream under Assam Higher Secondary Education Council (AHSEC), Guwahati and Undergraduate Pass courses in as many as six subjects of Arts and humanities viz. English, Bengali, Economics, Education, Political Science, and Sociology following CBCS system under Assam University (Central University), Silchar.
The necessary infrastructure of the Model College such as Academic Building, Library Building etc is completed. In the last academic session, we have celebrated all the significant national days and several other co-curricular activities that are generally observed in an academic institution. Amidst the ongoing academic activities infrastructural development such as residential complex for teaching and non-teaching staff, girls’ hostel, canteen, boundary wall, and principal’s residence etc are going on in full suing.
Taking note of the New Education Policy of the Government of India, our college is striving to promote skill-based knowledge, inclusive growth of education, participatory culture and value-based approach in addition to its regular courses in the near future. Our college shall remain ever proactive in developing its academic dimensions in terms of quality teaching, innovative practices and research to fulfil the requirement of all the stake holders. I feel privileged to mention that we have a group of experienced, qualified, dynamic and energetic faculty members committed to their profession and dedicated towards the greater interest of the students. I hope that our students will be able to excel in their academic and intellectual pursuits through this institution.
Finally, I extend my warm welcome to all the learners who are desirous of getting themselves admitted in this great institution of higher education. Our holistic approach towards education will have an ever-lasting impact on the formation of the life and character of the learners. The college is committed to extending all possible co-operations in helping the students in their quest for attaining outstanding careers.
Principal
Dr. Sahabuddin Ahmed
M.A, Ph.D. (G.U)
